posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
thalesgal said:
if it’s something that it’s not too complex
Click to expand...
It is something too complex.
You want 8 frames of a left and right directional sprite, plus a 4 frame idle, and a 4 frame behavior, at a size...I'm not sure, but maybe 96px tall?
This is a tall ask, that is made all the more difficult because this is for a very specific use case.
I am not familiar with the character you are talking about, but it appears to be one of the Maker's RTP characters, which is good, but most people are likely going to want it to be in the same size as the RTP, and probably want all that extra stuff for like...you know, the default RM perspective. So all of that means this winds up being very specific to your game, reducing the chances of anyone taking this on.
I would also assume you already have an animation solution set up in your game since, by default, RPG Maker doesn't support idles and behavior animations, so I am not sure how you plan to rig that up.

posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
An alternate idea would be to go for a retro style (I mean, you seem to plan for a different style for that scene anyways). Upscaling the sprite by 200%, maybe colorgrading it to match a retroish tileset, and you are good, with maybe just a few pose tweaks (though if I think about the old Super Mario Games for example, there is not that many poses anyways).
And in fact, I just tried: upscaled he works as is, though I slightly tweaked the colors on that one just to see if it is doing much. If you just edit the head to be a little smaller (to be honest: 95% cut and paste and then fixing a few pixels) and make him just 1-2 px slimmer (especially take 1 px width out of the arm and the leg) you can pretty much slap him onto a random free 16x16 also upscaled platformer tileset and are good to go.
It will still be a work that is likely only to be used by you, but as said, just having tried it, the narrowing of those 3 sideview default sprites and maybe a very very limited set of simple poses and then upscaling is something I would think you can try to do yourself and you will still end up with something really cool and unique.
